title: fix(boot): ambient actor boot.md is 463.7k chars, over the 150k limit of claude-code
description:
## .what

claude-code warns at session start:

```
.agent/.actors/actor.via.repo=ambient/brain/.claude/boot.md is over the 150.0k-char limit (463.7k chars)
```

`/context` reports the file at ~188k tokens: 19% of a 1m window spent before the first message.

## .the first move: measure per role

the file concatenates every enrolled role's say-level briefs and skills. no per-role breakdown is measured yet. sort the chars by `repo=*/role=*` before any cut, and let the largest group name the cause.

## .the likely levers

- demote say-level briefs to ref in each role's `boot.yml`
- ship `.md.min` twins for the long say-level briefs
- trim the role set the ambient actor enrolls
- a role owned by another repo is fixed there: dispatch a task upstream per role over budget

## .the clamp

a session on the ambient actor starts with no over-limit notice for boot.md.
